about: Varmora Granito makes and sells tiles, mainly glazed vitrified tiles (GVT) and technical products, plus bathware and adhesives. It runs eight manufacturing facilities in the Morbi cluster, Gujarat, and sells through 305 exclusive brand outlets and 2,758 multi brand outlets across 988 cities, with 21.11% of product sales from exports.

other.name: GVT and technical products share of tile revenue

objects.purpose: Repayment/prepayment of borrowings of the Company and wholly-owned subsidiaries (Covertek Ceramica, Varmora Sanitarywares)
General corporate purposes (capped at 25% of gross proceeds)

promoters.background: Promoters hold 25.38% directly; Promoters and Promoter Group together hold 52.01% pre-Offer. Katsura Investments is the Investor Selling Shareholder selling 26,217,634 shares.

concentration.note: B2C retail chain (EBOs and MBOs, run through franchisees) was 66.80% of domestic sales in Fiscal 2026; all manufacturing is in Morbi, Gujarat; exports 21.11% of product sales.

litigation_note: Against the Company: 1 criminal, 19 tax and 1 regulatory proceeding, about Rs 5.53 crore quantified; a Gujarat Pollution Control Board environmental compensation demand (coal gasifier order) is ongoing. Company has filed 56 cheque-bounce cases (Rs 7.29 crore). Against Directors 2 criminal; against Promoters 1 criminal.
strengths: GVT and technical products are 84.19% of tile revenue in FY26, up from 75.37% in FY24, a premium mix that lifted gross margin to 37.92%.
Eight in-house plants in Morbi make 81.72% of revenue, giving control over quality and cost.
Pan-India reach of 305 exclusive and 2,758 multi brand outlets across 988 cities in 24 states and UTs.
EBO share of domestic tile sales rose from 24.90% in FY24 to 27.72% in FY26, helping brand recall.
Over 3,500 tile SKUs and over 2,900 new SKUs launched since April 2023, including SACMI-backed IST marble-look tiles.
EBITDA margin improved from 10.21% in FY24 to 14.18% in FY26 and operating cash flow was Rs 234 crore in FY26.
IPO proceeds of Rs 245 crore go to debt repayment; borrowings to equity was 0.44x in FY26 versus 0.68x in FY25.
Founder-led team with over 23 years of operating history and an independent board.

risks.title: Single-region manufacturing
risks.detail: All own and contract manufacturing is in Morbi, Gujarat, and in-house plants make 81.72% of FY26 revenue; any disruption there would hit the whole business.

risks.title: Heavy borrowings and thin profitability
risks.detail: Total borrowings were Rs 357.95 crore in FY26 (Rs 505.16 crore in FY25); interest coverage is only 1.89x and PAT margin 3.53%. Rs 245 crore of IPO proceeds goes to debt repayment.

risks.title: Product concentration in GVT
risks.detail: GVT and technical products are 73.98% of FY26 revenue from operations; a demand slowdown or price war would hurt revenues and margins.

risks.title: Dependence on franchised retail network
risks.detail: B2C retail (EBOs and MBOs, all run via franchisees) was 66.80% of domestic sales in FY26, so franchisee non-performance can hurt sales.

risks.title: Export and foreign-market exposure
risks.detail: Exports were 21.11% of product sales in FY26 (24.01% in FY24), exposing the company to foreign laws, currency swings and trade disruptions.

risks.title: Litigation and environmental demand
risks.detail: 1 criminal, 19 tax and 1 regulatory case against the Company (about Rs 5.53 crore quantified) plus an ongoing GPCB environmental compensation demand tied to the NGT coal gasifier ban.

risks.title: Acquisition and conflict-of-interest risk
risks.detail: Rs 25 crore invested in Allemby (50% JV, Assam plant started July 2026, a month late); subsidiaries and group companies share similar business lines, creating conflicts.

risks.title: Valuation and promoter influence
risks.detail: Peer P/E ranges 28.55 to 72.00 while own FY26 EPS is only Rs 3.08; promoters and group keep 52.01% pre-Offer and an investor sells 26.2 million shares via OFS.

notes: FY26 restated consolidated, Rs million converted to crore. Source tables were garbled; columns were reconciled via totals (EBITDA = PBT+finance+D&A, net debt and cash-flow cross-checks). Net worth = total equity incl. non-controlling interest (Rs 810.22 crore); reserves = other equity. EBITDA is before exceptional items. PBT 753.91 mn is after share of associate loss 7.74 mn. PAT margin reported on total income (3.53%); on revenue it is 3.64%. Price band, issue size, OFS value, post-issue shares and P/E blank in RHP. Peer CMP not given. Q1FY27 stub not used.
